8.6.3.17 EnableCondition
[SWS_Dem_00604] Definition of ClientServerInterface EnableCondition
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04192
⌈
Name
EnableCondition
Comment
If at least one enable condition is configured it provide the capability to set an enable condition.
One port of this interface type is provided per enable condition by the Dem Service
Component. It has EnableConditionId as a port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
